أَسْوَسُ A beast having the disease termed سَوَسٌ. (K.) [Freytag, misled by an ambiguity in the K, assigns to it a signification belonging to سَوَسٌ.] ＝
-A2- Also, [or أَسْوَسٌ, unless originally an epithet,] A kind of stone upon which is generated the salt called زَهْرَةُ أَسْوَس: the author of the “ Minháj ” says that this may be caused by the moisture and dew of the sea falling upon it. (TA in art. سيس.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
